scope: Ovarian carcinoma predictive/prognostic/diagnostic biomarkers. Internal substrate only.

biomarker_records.scoring: Pathogenic BRCA1/2 alteration present vs absent.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Gates PARP-inhibitor therapy (maintenance and treatment) in high-grade serous/epithelial ovarian cancer; also informs risk-reducing surgery and cascade testing.

assay: genomic-scar/signature assays (LOH, telomeric imbalance, large-scale transitions) + BRCA status
biomarker_records.scoring: HRD-positive vs HRD-negative by validated composite score (beyond BRCA alone).
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: HRD-positive status (BRCA-mutant or HR-deficient by genomic scar) broadens PARP-inhibitor benefit beyond BRCA mutation alone, especially with bevacizumab maintenance.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: PARP maintenance trials with HRD companion dx

biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Diagnostic/histotyping: WT1 positivity supports serous lineage (HGSC/LGSC); negativity points to clear cell, endometrioid, or mucinous. Histotype then drives the therapeutic pathway.

biomarker_records.scoring: Aberrant patterns (diffuse overexpression OR complete null) = mutant-pattern; wild-type = heterogeneous moderate staining.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Diagnostic: aberrant p53 supports HGSC; wild-type p53 in a WT1+ serous tumor supports LGSC — a distinction that changes the entire treatment approach.

biomarker_records.scoring: MMR protein loss / MSI-high; most relevant in endometrioid and clear cell histotypes.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Identifies Lynch syndrome candidates and gates tumor-agnostic checkpoint inhibitor therapy in dMMR cases.
Diagnostic for clear cell carcinoma (WT1-negative, p53 wild-type, Napsin A+) — histotype that is relatively chemo-resistant and managed differently.
HER2-positive mucinous ovarian carcinoma may be a candidate for HER2-directed approaches (emerging/trial context).

notes: Ovarian biomarkers split cleanly into diagnostic-histotyping IHC (WT1, p53, Napsin A/HNF1-beta) and therapy-gating molecular (BRCA, HRD, dMMR, HER2). BRCA/HRD -> PARP is the headline therapeutic axis. Somatic BRCA via ctDNA is a Liquid Pulse crossover. Verify HRD assay cutoffs and PARP indications at write time.
